libraryPreparationPreflight.agent_guidance: Test FastInfosetCodec/FastInfosetStreamSOAPCodec directly at the unit level (build a Packet/SOAP message, encode it, assert the output is Fast Infoset binary - e.g. starts with the FI magic byte 0xE0 - then decode it back) rather than attempting end-to-end HTTP content negotiation. This matches the existing unit-test style already used for the sibling com.sun.xml.ws:rt and com.sun.xml.ws:jaxws-rt artifacts in this repo and avoids needing a servlet container or Docker image. No environment variables or system properties are required.

libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: rt-fi is a thin optional Fast Infoset codec plug-in for the JAX-WS RI core runtime; its codec classes implement rt's StreamSOAPCodec/Packet-based API, so meaningful tests need com.sun.xml.ws:rt directly on the test classpath (rt-fi is meant to sit alongside an rt/jaxws-rt install, the classic 'provided scope' bridge-module pattern). No Docker image or system property is needed - FastInfoset is pure in-memory binary XML encoding.
